mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts (id, customer_id, country, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{country}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO balances (id, account_id, currency, amount, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{currency}, #{amount}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, currency, amount, updated_at FROM balances WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND currency = #{currency} FOR UPDATE
